note: empty-sdk-refused: the pair empties a document whose importer throws; lolesports (valid OpenAPI, its example builder overflows on a required self-referencing allOf) keeps generating under the valid-OpenAPI exception, tacd (a null Media Type Object, invalid) is refused in both modes.
empty-sdk-refused: a Media Type Object written as null is invalid OpenAPI the pair empties; crozier refuses it in both modes as the new class null-media-type.

The pair resolves a header $ref into another operation's response headers and generates, so crozier does; a response or parameter $ref into #/paths/ empties the SDK, so DigitalOcean, dggs and Codat stay refused (empty-sdk-refused).
empty-sdk-refused: section A's response or parameter $ref into another path's definition empties the pair's SDK; crozier refuses DigitalOcean, propresenter-remote and pro7.9 in both modes.
empty-sdk-refused: an error response naming an undeclared components/responses entry empties the pair's SDK; crozier refuses both Setu documents in both modes.

No empty SDK: the pair types a schema $ref to a missing relative file, and an inline body mapped to pointers outside #/components/schemas/, as typing.Any and generates; crozier matches, warning once per missing file.
empty-sdk-refused: an extension reaching back into its own schema through an object member overflows the pair's importer into an empty SDK; crozier refuses both Stripe documents in both modes.
empty-sdk-refused: a response $ref naming something other than a components/responses entry empties the pair's SDK; crozier refuses arm-server and both PagerDuty documents in both modes.
